summary_for_children: Al-Humazah warns those who mock and backbite and who collect and count wealth thinking it will last.
environment_concept: An empty counting room at dusk: a table heaped with coins, an open ledger and an abacus, and locked chests along the wall. No person is shown. The Day of Judgement and the Fire are not pictured.
architecture_and_scenery: A small room open on one side, a counting table, chests, an abacus, a ledger.

areas.name: Counting Table
areas.description: A table heaped with coins, an open ledger and an abacus, all left behind.

areas.name: Locked Chests
areas.description: A row of locked chests. Wealth kept in them cannot make anyone live forever.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A village square on a windy afternoon ringed by four houses, each with a chalk noticeboard by its door

primary_mechanic.text: At four boards with mocking chalk (the baker, the old shepherd, the new girl, the potter): laughing along or walking past is refused; scrub the board clean, then choose between a kind true line and a flattering untrue one; flattery is refused (kind words must be true; 104:1).

secondary_activities: no! (104:4-5, read; the fire is never shown)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the lane, the boards, then a reading by the oak
environment_behaviour: each board changes from scrawled to neat writing
unique_world.learning_objective: Do not mock or slander anyone (104:1)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Power of Words
story_library.children_narration: Words can make someone feel welcome, or they can hurt. Surah Al-Humazah warns against mocking others, speaking badly about people, and becoming overly attached to wealth. We should choose our words carefully.

world_idea.title: The Town of Kind Words
world_idea.description: Take part in communication challenges where harmful statements can be replaced with respectful responses.
